description:
The fastest way to learn to express yourself confidently: https://bit.ly/028-25

Diary Of A CEO Podcast: @TheDiaryOfACEO 
My Diary Of A CEO Episode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zg4Ta7vXiIM


Most people think charisma is about how you talk. But the real superpower lies in how you listen.

In this video, we break down the subtle listening habits that make Steven Bartlett one of the most captivating conversationalists alive. You’ll learn how to hold silence, guide emotion, and create moments where people feel seen in ways they rarely do.


0:00 - Intro
1:14 - #1: Steven almost never interrupts
3:52 - #2: Offer the least invasive support possible
7:00 - #3: Offer an empathetic mirror
8:51 - #4: Ask chunky questions
9:32 - #5: Presence matters more than technique
